Unauthorized Access to Knowledge Base S3 Bucket [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-284] on KnowledgeBaseBucket, DataProcessingLambda: Attackers could exploit misconfigured bucket policies, overly permissive IAM roles, or leaked AWS credentials to access sensitive documents in the S3 bucket. An attacker obtains AWS credentials from a public code repository or through a compromised system and uses them to download sensitive documents from the S3 bucket.

Token Exposure in Client-Side Storage [Information Disclosure, Spoofing, CWE-522] on CognitoUserPool, NextJSWebApplication: Storing authentication tokens in browser localStorage or sessionStorage makes them vulnerable to XSS attacks and malicious browser extensions. An attacker exploits an XSS vulnerability to inject JavaScript that extracts authentication tokens from localStorage and sends them to a malicious server.

PII Exposure Through AI Responses [Information Disclosure, CWE-359] on BedrockClaudeModel, OpenSearchServerless, DynamoDBChatHistory: The AI model might include PII in its responses or store sensitive information in chat history, leading to potential privacy violations. A user asks questions that prompt the AI to reveal PII from the knowledge base or previous conversations.

Code Execution via User Input [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-94] on ECSFargateService, DataProcessingLambda: Attackers could attempt to inject malicious code through chat inputs or file uploads that could be executed in the application environment. An attacker crafts special input that exploits input validation vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the Fargate container.

Insecure Authentication Flow [Spoofing, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-287] on CognitoUserPool, ApplicationLoadBalancer: Weaknesses in authentication implementation could allow attackers to bypass authentication or hijack sessions. An attacker intercepts authorization codes or exploits missing PKCE implementation to gain unauthorized access.

Vector Database Query Injection [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-943] on OpenSearchServerless, ECSFargateService: Attackers could craft malicious inputs that exploit vector database query vulnerabilities to access or manipulate data. An attacker injects malicious parameters into vector similarity search queries to extract unauthorized data.

Insecure Network Configuration [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-668] on VPC, SecurityGroups, VPCEndpoints: Overly permissive security groups or improperly configured VPC endpoints could allow unauthorized network access. An attacker exploits overly permissive security group rules to access internal services directly.

Insufficient Logging and Monitoring [Repudiation, CWE-778] on All AWS Services: Without proper logging and monitoring, attackers could perform malicious activities without detection. An attacker gains access to the system and exfiltrates data, but the activity goes unnoticed due to insufficient logging.
